summary: Apex Global Solutions is seeking an AI-powered system to automate the extraction of lease and contract data from PDFs into their SAP ERP system. The project focuses on high accuracy (92%+), strict Azure-based data residency, and a significant reduction in manual labor costs and financial risks associated with missed contract dates.
industry_sector: Enterprise Operations / LegalTech / Real Estate Management

assumptions.description: Historical data in SharePoint is accessible and structured enough for initial ingestion testing.
The SAP/Property Management DB has available RESTful API endpoints for data ingestion.
The 15,000 historical documents are representative of future document variety and complexity.

requirement_priorities.requirement_text: All model training and execution must occur strictly within Apex's private Microsoft Azure tenant (US-East).
requirement_priorities.rationale: Explicitly stated as a strict residency requirement.
This is the primary success metric for the project to mitigate financial risk.

requirement_priorities.requirement_text: Bidders must provide explicit rate cards and architectural assumptions for Phase 2: Scaling, Retraining, and Drift Handling.
requirement_priorities.rationale: Proposals lacking this will be disqualified.

open_questions.question: What are the specific schemas and API documentation for the SAP/Property Management DB?
Is there a specific LLM or OCR engine preference within the Azure ecosystem (e.g., Azure AI Document Intelligence, GPT-4o)?
What is the expected volume growth beyond the current 200 documents per month?

risks.description: Financial risk from missed notice windows (currently $350k/year) if the system fails to extract key dates accurately.
Data privacy risk due to the presence of PII and confidential trade terms in lease documents.

coverage_gaps.description: While 99.5% uptime is mentioned, specific requirements for logging, alerting, and performance monitoring of the AI models (e.g., drift detection) are not detailed.
The RFP does not specify how long processed data or intermediate OCR outputs should be retained within the Azure environment.

inferred_requirements.requirement: The system should be scalable to handle peak processing loads without degrading performance below the 3-minute threshold.
inferred_requirements.rationale: The current volume is 200/month, but enterprise growth or batch uploads may require handling higher peak loads than the average rate suggests.
acceptance_criteria: System must demonstrate stable performance when processing 50+ documents simultaneously.

inferred_requirements.requirement: The HITL interface should provide deep-linking or highlighting of source text within the PDF for verified fields.
inferred_requirements.rationale: For the HITL interface to be effective, human reviewers need to quickly verify the source of the extraction.
acceptance_criteria: Users can view the specific page and paragraph in the PDF where a data point was extracted.

requirements_register.description: Automate extraction of structured data (lease terms, financial obligations, dates) from complex multi-page PDF documents.
acceptance_criteria: Successful extraction of key fields from both scanned and native PDFs.
Data successfully flows from SharePoint into the AI engine and then into the SAP/Property Management DB.
requirements_register.description: Integrate with Microsoft SharePoint for ingestion and SAP/Property Management DB for output via RESTful APIs.
Provide a Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) interface for verification of extractions with confidence scores below 88%.
acceptance_criteria: The system presents a UI for human review when the model confidence score for an extraction is below 88%.

requirements_register.description: Achieve an extraction accuracy of 92% or higher across all fields.
acceptance_criteria: Monthly audit of 100 random documents shows ≥ 92% accuracy against ground truth.
System telemetry logs confirm processing time is under 3 minutes per document.
requirements_register.description: Processing speed must be less than 3 minutes per document from upload to database population.

acceptance_criteria: Vendor provides SOC 2 Type II certification and demonstrates AES-256 and TLS 1.3 implementation.
requirements_register.description: Compliance with SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA/GDPR, and encryption standards (AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit).
The implementation must follow a 26-week timeline across five phases.

acceptance_criteria: All data processing remains within the specified Azure regions.
requirements_register.description: All model training and execution must occur strictly within Apex's private Microsoft Azure tenant (US-East / East-US-2).

acceptance_criteria: Proposal includes multi-year maintenance cost projections.
requirements_register.description: Proposals must include explicit rate cards and architectural assumptions for scaling, retraining, and drift handling.
Automate the extraction and validation of contractual terms to reduce error rates and financial risk.
Achieve a 50% reduction in operational costs.
